componentInstanceProperties.value: Metrios: the optical measuring machine for all components

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
In the realm of modern industry, the need to control and ensure the quality of mechanical components is crucial. However, certain types of parts may undergo irreversible deformations when subjected to physical manipulations.

In response to this need, a revolutionary solution has emerged: Metrios .
The Metrios non-contact system eliminates the risk of undesired deformations, allows for greater efficiency and speed in quality control processes. 

Metrios finds application in sectors where precision is crucial, and physical manipulation can compromise component integrity. Industries such as aerospace, electronics, and medical device manufacturing will benefit significantly.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: How does Metrios work?

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
Metrios measuring machine uses advanced image analysis and data analysis technologies to obtain an accurate representation of the parts under examination. Through the use of a high-resolution camera and telecentric optics, it captures precise details without any contact.

The software then interprets this information to calculate the dimensions and shape of the components with unparalleled precision.

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value: ✨ And what about the advantages? ✨

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
• AVOID DEFORMATION: By eliminating the need to touch the parts, Metrios prevents potential deformations, ensuring product integrity.
  • INCREASE PRODUCTIVITY: Optical measurement is extremely fast, allowing for efficient evaluation without slowing down production processes.
  • MAXIMUM PRECISION: The combination of advanced sensors and sophisticated software in Metrios ensures extremely high measurement accuracy.
  • ADAPTABILITY: The machine can be configured to adapt to a wide range of components, making it versatile in various industrial contexts.
